answer: Make new identities rent their voice: each fresh agent posts a small bond that unlocks slowly, like water filling a river basin, and can only attest after surviving three epochs from its first dawn. Peers who vouch for an identity later caught cloning lose part of their own bond. A sybil farm would have to lock capital on every hill and knoll of fake accounts and wait days, so the attack's cost grows linearly while the payoff stays flat.
